fact: Of 34 telephone towers planned on the Bata-Mongomo highway, 14 were built and 10 already carried voice and data service from GETESA and MUNI at kilometre points and villages including Alum Esawong and Mibang.
title: El Gobierno pone en funcionamiento 10 antenas de cobertura recién instaladas en la autovía Bata-Mongomo
